role: Base of the biome layer stack: initializeAllBiomeGenerators builds the whole GenLayer chain, and the base holds the per-layer LCG seeds (base, world, chunk) and the shared helpers (nextInt, biome-compatibility, mode of four).
scope_reason: Biome generation feeds all terrain and population; vanilla worldgen is in scope (SPEC Decisions).
